coverage_is_input: freeze_partition(coverage_start, coverage_end, ...) NEVER fabricates dates; the authoritative freeze runs at integration once A2's accepted coverage is known. Nothing in this file freezes a real partition.

rule.s1: the most recent 12 COMPLETE calendar months of the coverage, non-overlapping with S0, SEALED; a month is complete only if its month-end is <= coverage_end
rule.s1_blocked: if 12 complete months do not fit, freeze_partition raises PartitionError('S1_CANNOT_BE_FORMED') and the cycle closes STOCKS_FREE_V1_BLOCKED_S1_ISOLATION (PLAN 4.2)
rule.warmup: the first 63 regular sessions of the coverage; warmup may NOT contribute scored trades
rule.s0: every post-warmup session strictly before s1_start; at least 6 complete calendar years 'where possible' - a shortfall is RECORDED in s0_complete_years / s0_minimum_years_met / warnings, never silently accepted
rule.folds: 3 contiguous chronological folds of the S0 sessions (first folds get the remainder)
rule.purge: each fold's scored region ends 5 regular sessions (DEFAULT_PURGE_SESSIONS) before the fold end (force-flat boundary); no scored position may cross a fold boundary or into S1; the last fold's scored_end is strictly before s1_start
rule.digest: sha256 over canonical JSON of schema, rule id, coverage/warmup/s0/s1 boundaries, folds, purge, warmup, s0_complete_years

access_isolation.enforcement: path-filter only: any path under a sealed root, or embedding a date inside [s1_start, s1_end] (ISO or compact form), raises SealedWindowError; write modes are always rejected for research processes
access_isolation.staging_vs_research: staging layers may hash the complete delivery; research processes get the data root minus S1 (PLAN 4.2)

worked_example_NOT_AUTHORITATIVE.warning: EXAMPLE ONLY, computed from the staged SSGA coverage merely to show the rule fires; the real freeze uses A2's accepted coverage at integration

tests: tests/stocks_free_v1/test_partition.py: golden layout, mid-month coverage, blocked S1, force-flat purge arithmetic, digest stability/sensitivity, S1 sealing raises SealedWindowError, read-only enforcement
